== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Zero Hour / Liberation Of Lothal]] (original printing), Virtual Set 19, as the PC published it on 10 August 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/liberationoflothal.gif holotable commit 25528d7], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/liberationoflothal.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
